instruction: Email the birth certificate found in my file system to my husband.
notes: Three apps plus supervisor: phone (search_contacts filtered by relationship='husband' to discover the husband's email), file_system (show_directory with substring 'birth', recursive=true, to discover the birth certificate's path), gmail (send_email with email_addresses=[husband-email], attachment_file_paths=[path] and file_system_access_token). Static init facts contact-email/file-of represent database facts unknown to the agent until the lookup actions assert known-email/known-path; gmail-send-email requires both and asserts email-sent, which is the only task-specific goal besides task-completed. supervisor-complete-task carries the email-message/person/document records as non-API parameters so its precondition mirrors the goal; complete_task is called with no answer. The username object for phone is the supervisor's phone number, for file_system and gmail it is the supervisor's email.

plan: (gmail-send-email husband-email subject-birth-certificate body-birth-certificate file-system-token birth-certificate-path file-system-token husband birth-certificate email-to-husband)
